before.requirement: Call ucl_parser_free before returning from a failed ucl_parser_add_string call when ucl_parser_get_error reports a parse error.
before.reason: The input "{" reaches the unmatched-brace error path. The harness sees the error and returns without freeing the parser.

after.requirement: Call ucl_parser_free before returning from a failed ucl_parser_add_string call when ucl_parser_get_error reports a parse error.
after.reason: The same input reaches the unmatched-brace error path. The changed destructor can release additional owned state, but the harness still returns before calling it.

claims.reason: Both versions report the same reachable parse error, and the same old-harness early return bypasses parser cleanup on both sides.
